description: This file provides utility functions for tenant management within a frontend application. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs, get and set the active tenant in localStorage, fetch tenants associated with the current session, and select a tenant by communicating with backend endpoints. The code is focused on frontend routing utility for tenants, with no dependencies other than global fetch and localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId(t)
methods.description: Extracts a tenant ID from various object structures or string input, returning a string ID or null.

methods.name: getActiveTenant()
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from localStorage, preferring 'activeTenant' key and falling back to 'activeTenantId' for backward compatibility.

methods.name: setActiveTenant(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in localStorage. Also removes the legacy 'activeTenantId' key to ensure consistency.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant()
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from localStorage by invoking setActiveTenant with null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants()
methods.description: Fetches the list of tenants associated with the current session by making a GET request to '/api/session/tenants'. Handles network errors and non-OK responses.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user-selection')
methods.description: Selects a tenant via a POST request to '/api/tenants/select', updates localStorage and cookies for session context, and logs the action in development environments.
